<!-- Use English for the title, description, comments, and review feedback.
Preserve original diagnostics or quotations when needed and explain them in English.
Keep small PRs concise. Write None for inapplicable sections; do not invent evidence.
Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/development-workflow.md. -->

## Purpose
<!-- What problem does this solve, and why? Link the related issue, or describe the
agreed scope here if there is no issue. Use Closes # only when fully resolving it. -->

## Behavior changes
<!-- Describe the observable before/after behavior. For documentation or workflow
changes, explain what changes for contributors. -->

## Implementation and rationale
<!-- How does this work, and why this approach? Explain material tradeoffs and
why any added mechanism is needed. -->

## Requirements and evidence
<!-- Connect each material issue requirement to its implementation and supporting
validation. A short bullet list is enough for a small change; use a table if useful.
Identify unmet requirements or explicitly agreed scope changes. -->

## Validation
<!-- List checks actually run and their results. State relevant checks skipped and
why. Distinguish automated tests, manual inspection, and live-model evidence. -->

## Limitations and risks
<!-- Remaining gaps, compatibility or migration impact, risks, and linked follow-up
work. Write None if there are none. -->
